title: A plugin-data worker distill keeps the worktree's entry script but runs with the main checkout as its working directory
goal: With CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA set and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT a worker's worktree, ql_base.launch_places returns the worktree's own querylog.py entry and the clone's main checkout as the working directory, so the session-end distill still reads the plugin data spool and bl_procs.classify does not call a waiting distill an orphan that makes land refuse the worktree

run:
import os,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");os.environ["CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA"]=tempfile.mkdtemp();os.environ["CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"]=os.getcwd();import ql_base as q
e,c=q.launch_places();print("plugin-data distill: entry",e,"cwd",c,"main checkout",q.clone_home());sys.exit(0 if e==q.ENTRY and str(c)==str(q.clone_home()) else 1)

notes: Found by the SP-g2ssvhi2 review (S2): ST-oftholty's fix (88137f72a) returns (ENTRY, HOME) when plugin_data() is set, so ql_distill.detach (ql_distill.py:1152) starts the distill with cwd in the worker's worktree; bl_procs.hook_logs (bl_procs.py:169) matches only <checkout>/_cache/querylog/distill.log, so a plugin-data distill waiting on the lock classifies as orphan, not hook, and land refuses the worktree and selfcheck fails for up to USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S. The landed test asserts (worker entry, worker) and bakes that in. Plan SP-z3hyk4eh 2026-10-16, verified on origin/main 74c7ea6c6: ql_base.launch_places still returns (ENTRY, HOME) under plugin data (ql_base.py:65-66); the check runs it with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA set and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT this worktree and wants (this worktree's entry, the main checkout). The landed test the notes name was deleted under the test policy; none is added.
